hypotheses.title: Intraday VWAP Displacement Mean-Reversion (pv1 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP) represents the institutional execution benchmark. Stocks closing significantly above their daily VWAP reflect aggressive late-day retail/momentum chasing that overshoots fair value. Market makers absorb inventory and profit from predictable next-day mean-reversion. 100% instrument coverage and completely orthogonal to the existing portfolio (zero fundamental collinearity).
confounders: Major structural news breaks in the final trading hour
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during aggressive breakout momentum regimes where closing above VWAP triggers multi-day trend following.

hypotheses.title: 20-Day Channel Range Extremum Reversion (pv1 ts_scale - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Uses native WorldQuant ts_scale(close, 20) to compute exact position within the rolling 20-day dynamic channel. Stocks pinned to the absolute top of their 20-day range face profit-taking and institutional rebalancing supply, while stocks at the channel floor experience short covering. Bounded [0, 1] transformation guarantees zero weight concentration risk.
confounders: Sustained secular breakout trends lasting longer than 20 days
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during powerful structural macro bull runs where equities trend along the top channel boundary for months.

hypotheses.title: Intraday Candlestick Efficiency Mean-Reversion (pv1 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures the ratio of net daily directional move (close - open) to total intraday volatility (high - low), smoothed over a 5-day linear decay. Persistent one-sided directional intraday thrust exhausts liquidity, compensating contrarian liquidity providers. Dimensionless ratio eliminates all unit errors.
confounders: Pre-market gap openings with zero subsequent intraday movement
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when high-efficiency candles are driven by sustained fundamental multi-quarter revision cycles.
